predecessors.name: German Africa
predecessors.text: British Togoland: the Ghana part of Cliopatria's 1914 Togoland shape (79 cells), the British zone of the colony

successors.name: Ghana
successors.text: British Togoland: the Ghana part of Cliopatria's 1914 Togoland shape (79 cells), the British zone of the colony

ledger.x: 27 August 1914: British forces occupy western Togoland.
7 August 1914: French and British troops invade Togoland.
27 August 1914: the western zone is held by British forces.
27 December 1916: Togoland is divided into British and French zones.
27 December 1916: the British zone is administered as part of the Gold Coast.
28 June 1919: German title to Togoland ends with the Treaty of Versailles; the occupation of the British zone becomes tenure under the Allied settlement (the mandate follows on 20 July 1922).
20 July 1922: British Togoland becomes a Class B League of Nations mandate.
13 December 1946: the territory becomes a UN Trust Territory.
13 December 1956: the administrative link with the Gold Coast ends in the incorporation that precedes the union of 6 March 1957.
6 March 1957: British Togoland joins the new Ghana.

wars.name: Togoland campaign
wars.outcome: Allied victory: the colony surrendered on 26 August 1914 after a few skirmishes.

certainty.note: A wartime occupation line; the page does not give the boundary between the Anglo-French zones before the partition of 27 December 1916.

The Anglo-French zone line of the partition (1916), confirmed by the mandate (1922) and the trusteeship (1946); the page names no coordinates, so the line follows the gazetteer's Ghana part of the Togoland shape.
